  (:requirements :strips)
  (:predicates
    (on ?x ?y)
    (on-table ?x)
    (clear ?x)
    (holding ?x)
    (arm-empty)
    ; CONSTRAINT: stack-count / ok-stack-count enforce at most 3 stacks
    (stack-count ?n)
    (ok-stack-count ?n)
    (next-count ?low ?high)
    (prev-count ?high ?low)
  )
  (:action pickup
    :parameters (?b ?old ?new)
    :precondition (and
      (on-table ?b)
      (clear ?b)
      (arm-empty)
      (stack-count ?old)
      (ok-stack-count ?old)
      (prev-count ?old ?new)
      (ok-stack-count ?new)
    )
    :effect (and
      (holding ?b)
      (not (on-table ?b))
      (not (clear ?b))
      (not (arm-empty))
      (not (stack-count ?old))
      (stack-count ?new)
    )
  )
  (:action putdown
    :parameters (?b ?low ?high)
    :precondition (and
      (holding ?b)
      (stack-count ?low)
      (next-count ?low ?high)
      (ok-stack-count ?high)
    )
    :effect (and
      (on-table ?b)
      (clear ?b)
      (arm-empty)
      (not (holding ?b))
      (not (stack-count ?low))
      (stack-count ?high)
    )
  )
  (:action stack
    :parameters (?b ?c ?n)
    :precondition (and
      (holding ?b)
      (clear ?c)
      (stack-count ?n)
      (ok-stack-count ?n)
    )
    :effect (and
      (on ?b ?c)
      (clear ?b)
      (arm-empty)
      (not (holding ?b))
      (not (clear ?c))

    :precondition (and
      (on ?b ?c)
      (clear ?b)
      (arm-empty)
      (stack-count ?n)
      (ok-stack-count ?n)
    )
    :effect (and
      (holding ?b)
      (clear ?c)
      (not (on ?b ?c))
      (not (clear ?b))
      (not (arm-empty))
    )
  )
)",

      (when (not (= ?s none))
